description: This file defines the TypeScript interface 'PatchedExportLog' and associated functions for JSON serialization/deserialization, representing a data model for export logs in the Tandoor API.

methods.name: instanceOfPatchedExportLog
methods.description: Checks if a given object implements the PatchedExportLog interface.

methods.name: PatchedExportLogFromJSON
methods.description: Creates a PatchedExportLog object from a JSON object.

methods.name: PatchedExportLogFromJSONTyped
methods.description: Creates a PatchedExportLog object from a JSON object with optional discriminator handling.

methods.name: PatchedExportLogToJSON
methods.description: Serializes a PatchedExportLog object to JSON.
